title: Editor crash due to AccessKit "TreeUpdate includes duplicate child"
body:
### Tested versions

- Experienced in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f] and v4.6.stable.official
- (AccessKit was added in v4.5 and v4.4 is no longer supported, so we didn't go back to testing in v4.4 or earlier)

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f] - Godot v4.7.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated Gigabyte GTX 1080 - Intel Core i7-10700k - 32 GiB memory

### Issue description

At what seem like pretty random intervals, one member of our six person team is experiencing the Godot Editor crashing to desktop quite frequently (several times per hour). Looking at the log, the issue consistently seems to be:

```
thread '<unnamed>' (7360) panicked at /home/runner/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/accesskit_consumer-0.35.0/src/tree.rs:224:21:
TreeUpdate includes duplicate child #675246168345350
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```

Running with that RUST_BACKTRACE=1 environment variable set just produces a longer error messages with a bunch of memory address but no other useful information.

It took us a while to track down what the issue (seemingly?) is, so we're having the person experience this running with all Accessibility options in the Project and Editor disabled to see if this continues to occur or not.

[Godot4-7_AccessKit_TreeUpdate_DuplicateChild_crash.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30026594/Godot4-7_AccessKit_TreeUpdate_DuplicateChild_crash.txt)



### Steps to reproduce

Unfortunately, the crash seems intermittent. We're still trying to identify clear repro steps, but so far no clear pattern. Usually occurs after manipulating some 3D object (copying/paste, importing a new model, changing a texture) but reopening the project after the crash and repeating the exact same action will not reproduce the crash.

It is not the same as other open AccessKit issues ([this one](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/120999) or [this one](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/111028)) however, [this comment](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/111028#issuecomment-4262006442) is exactly the issue we've been experiencing. Someone on [the Godot forums](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/godot-crashes-repeatedly-how-to-debug/137146/21?page=2) was reporting the same issue as well.
